items.title: Take a short walk after meals
items.text: Your sugar rose about 22.3 mg/dL less after meals when you walked. Aim for 10 to 20 minutes after dinner, where the program saw the biggest gain (18.3 mg/dL). A check in real adults (CGMacros) pointed the same way, at about a fifth of the program's size, but it is not proven there yet.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: When you had dinner at 8 pm or later, your sugar rose about 28.0 mg/dL more, which happened 63.6% of the time. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to see how it affects your sugar.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: You averaged 13.6 hours of overnight fasting, with 66.7% of nights reaching 13 hours. Adding an overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points compared to coaching alone in the program.
